text: Visitors have raised concerns about the requirement to purchase tickets online well in advance, with no option to buy tickets at the library, leading to frustration for those who travel without prior reservations. Parking and traffic flow around the site were frequently criticized for being poorly designed, especially for larger vehicles, and there was a lack of clear communication about security procedures and ticket availability in the parking area. Some reviews described long lines and crowding at entry points, as well as limited restroom access while waiting. Despite these issues, many visitors appreciated the interactive exhibits and the architecture, but the timed entry system and ticket sellouts contributed to dissatisfaction among some guests.

Parking was another common concern, with complaints about narrow lanes, limited camper parking, and poor signage. Some reviews also noted long lines and a lack of communication about security procedures and ticket availability upon arrival. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits, the overall experience was negatively affected by these operational issues.
